title: endymion lingulatus
intro: Endymion lingulatus, commonly known as the green-veined helleborine, is a type of orchid native to Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its unique green-striped flowers and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine. The health benefits of Endymion lingulatus include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects.
